study.en: There is a desk in the study.
Dad reads in the study after dinner every night.
study.cn: 爸爸每天晚饭后在书房看书。

bathroom.en: Wash your hands in the bathroom.
Our bathroom is small but very clean.
bathroom.cn: 我们的浴室不大但很干净。

table.en: Put the cup on the table.
We eat dinner around the table every night.
table.cn: 我们每天晚上围着桌子吃饭。

lamp.en: The lamp on my desk makes the room bright.
lamp.cn: 我桌上的灯让房间变亮。

bed.en: My bed is so soft that I fall asleep in minutes.
bed.cn: 我的床很软，几分钟就睡着了。

door.en: Someone is knocking at the door — please go and open it.
door.cn: 有人在敲门——请去开一下。

garden.en: Grandpa grows many vegetables in the garden behind our house.
garden.cn: 爷爷在我们家屋后的花园里种了很多蔬菜。

upstairs.en: Run upstairs and bring me my book, please.
upstairs.cn: 请跑到楼上把我的书拿下来。
